info.title: CargaExpress Supply Chain API
info.description: CargaExpress Control Tower Logistics: APIs for WMS order orchestration, carrier tracking, dynamic state mapping, and exception management.

get.description: Check service availability and report database connection status. Always returns HTTP 200 with connectivity detail (up/down).

200.description: Service health status and database connectivity.

get.description: Returns 200 only when the database is reachable.

200.description: The service is ready to serve traffic.

post.description:
Receive push tracking events from Type A carrier webhooks (F3 / RNF-01).

Decodes heterogeneous payloads and publishes to RabbitMQ queue `eventos_transportadora`
for asynchronous processing, guaranteeing response time < 200 ms (RNF-01).

schema.title: Response Receive Carrier Webhook Api V1 Webhooks  Carrier Slug  Post

post.description:
Trigger periodic polling connector for Type B carriers (F4 / Airflow batch hook).

Queries carrier REST APIs, respects rate limits with exponential backoff,
and passes all tracking events through NormalizationService (RN-01 / RN-02).

parameters.name: carrier_name

schema.description: Optional carrier name to sync. If omitted, syncs all 4 Type B carriers.
schema.title: Carrier Name

parameters.description: Optional carrier name to sync. If omitted, syncs all 4 Type B carriers.

schema.title: Response Trigger Type B Sync Api V1 Sync Type B Post

post.description:
Upload and ingest a Type C batch file (CSV or Excel).

Cleans known defects (repeated headers, total/summary rows),
prevents duplicate ingestion via SHA-256 and filename tracking,
and normalizes all valid tracking events using NormalizationService.

schema.title: Response Upload Type C File Api V1 Sync Type C Upload Post

get.description: Retrieve all configured status mappings, optionally filtered by carrier ID.

200.description: List of state mappings retrieved successfully.

schema.title: Response List Mappings Api V1 Admin State Mappings Get

post.description: Register a new single mapping between a carrier's raw status and a canonical status.

409.description: Mapping already exists for this carrier and status.

422.description: Validation error in payload (e.g. invalid canonical status or blank raw status).

get.summary: Translate raw carrier status to canonical status (HU-12)
get.description: Translate a carrier's raw status to the normalized canonical status using the in-memory cache.

404.description: No mapping found for given status.

patch.summary: Partially update an existing state mapping (HU-12)
patch.description: Modify the raw status or canonical status of an existing mapping by its ID.

409.description: Updated raw status conflicts with an existing mapping.

delete.description: Remove a state mapping record by its primary key ID.

get.summary: Retrieve state mappings for a specific carrier (HU-15)
get.description: Retrieve all current status mappings configured for the given carrier directly from the database.

put.summary: Replace entire state mapping set for a carrier (HU-15)
put.description: Synchronize and replace the complete set of status mappings for a carrier in an atomic transaction.

422.description: Validation error in payload (e.g. invalid canonical status or duplicate raw status).

post.summary: Create a new order with lines and recipient (HU-13)
post.description: Create an order with its mandatory child lines and recipient details. Validates that referenced brand, distribution center, and shipment type exist.

404.description: Referenced brand, distribution center, or shipment type not found.

409.description: Order reference already exists for this brand.

422.description: Validation error in entity or payload.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of orders, including total count and pagination metadata.

get.description: List all active orders currently meeting the RN-04 at-risk criteria (< 24 business hours remaining or unresolved exception > 12 hours). Intended for the control-tower coordinator, with optional brand filtering.

get.description: Exposes the calculated SLA deadline (business days excluding Sundays and destination holidays), compliance status (MET, MISSED, PENDING), and at-risk assessment for the specified order.
